speaker: Mr Desmond Choo
text: asked the Minister for Education (Schools) (a) how does the Ministry ensure that the teachers and career guidance counsellors deployed to our schools are kept abreast with updated industry and employment trends; and (b) what collaborations does the Ministry have with SkillsFuture Singapore (SSG), Workforce Singapore (WSG) and Employment and Employability Institute (e2i) to provide an integrated career support for our students.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
text: With this knowledge, they are able to advise and provide up-to-date, suitable career guidance to the students.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
text: Through the MySkillsFuture portal, students gain insights into industries and occupations, as well as the education pathways leading to them.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
text: Upon graduation, students can continue to use the MySkillsFuture portal to manage their career and learning plans as they enter the workforce.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
text: These events also help to acquaint students with the services provided by SSG, WSG and e2i.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
text: We will continue to work with the agencies to expand the collaboration and increase the frequency of such activities.

speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
text: MOE has a good suite of services provided to the students.

speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
text: What is critical for the ECG Counsellors is also a career path that they can build on, so that they grow their industry depth and knowledge to help our students and progress with them over the years.

speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
text: What are the plans that MOE has to grow the careers of our ECG Counsellors?

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: I wish to thank Mr Desmond Choo for his very thoughtful question for the ECG Counsellors.

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: I also want to assure the Member that ECG Counsellors are very well plugged into the latest on the various industries.

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: So, we support them to make sure they are current and also that they are kept up-to-date and are kept abreast of the market and employment trends.

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: Our ECG Counsellors come with prior work experience from different sectors.

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: We make sure that, on the job, they get the necessary support from industry, from MOE.

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: Each ECG Counsellor is really part of a committed team of ECG personnel, comprising teachers, class advisors and also lecturers in schools or even in post-Secondary Education Institutes (PSEIs).

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: They also have the support from the MOE Grange Road ECG Centre, especially during critical periods, such as the release of national examination results.

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: So, they receive on-the-job support and, when they join us, we give them the professional training.

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: We remain committed to nurturing our ECG Counsellors with regular training and also promising career prospects.

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: Opportunities will be made available for good performers for senior appointments, such as Senior ECG Counsellor and ECG Counselling Manager positions.

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: I wish to thank the Member for the supplementary questions.

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: Other than the regular sharing and networking sessions that we arrange with WSG and e2i career coaches, MOE also works with private sector and public sector agencies on a monthly basis.

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: The ECG Counsellors will set aside at least half a day every month to attend industry networking sessions and sharing sessions.

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: Some of the organisations involved include CAAS, talking about the opportunities in T4 and the new T5; LinkedIn; MOH, talking about the job opportunities made available in healthcare; and also Action Community for Entrepreneurship, so that the ECG Counsellors are well-placed to advise students who are keen on entrepreneurial pathways.

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: I want to assure Members that there is a robust approach as to which industry partner to work with in terms of organising the regular industry networking and sharing sessions.

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: Typically, these partners are selected to cover a broad spectrum of industries.

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: We have, especially, a focus on sectors with opportunities for growth and where future jobs will be.

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: Some of the sectors that have been covered in the last two years include aerospace, logistics, social services, media, the built environment and so on.

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: We make sure that even after they join us, with the prior work experience that they have, the ECG Counsellors are always given regular updates on the market and employment trends as well as industrial insights.
